input: We need to partition LLC (Last Level Cache) between CPU clusters and a real-time audio workload using MPAMv2. The ARMv9.7-A spec mentions independent PARTIDs and 16-bit PMGs. Currently our cache partitioning via resctrl only gives 8 partitions. How do we configure MPAMv2 for finer-grained partitioning, and what happens if we exhaust the PARTID space with too many VMs each wanting their own partition?
